task.title: Troubleshoot a Kubernetes Pod using logs, exec, and events
task.shortdesc: Diagnose common Pod issues by inspecting logs, executing commands in containers, and reviewing events.

step.cmd: Check Pod status and recent restarts: kubectl get pods -n <ns> -l app=<app>.
Describe the failing Pod to see events and probe failures: kubectl describe pod/<podName> -n <ns>.
View container logs (current): kubectl logs pod/<podName> -n <ns> --container=<containerName>.
If the container restarted, view previous logs: kubectl logs pod/<podName> -n <ns> --previous --container=<containerName>.
Exec into the container to inspect runtime state: kubectl exec -it pod/<podName> -n <ns> --container=<containerName> -- sh.
Check namespace events sorted by time: kubectl get events -n <ns> --sort-by=.lastTimestamp.
